bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USSD has canonical native issuance on Sonic through the BrandedCustodian/BrandedFactory path. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Scroll are Frax branded-token representations reached through CrossChainRouter redemption and LayerZero RemoteHop/FraxtalHop composition; their local custodians, factories, ProxyAdmin owners, router roles, Hop peers, five-DVN validation, executors, treasuries, pause, admin, and recovery surfaces are assessed here. CCTP v2 remains a secondary USDC redemption rail whose USSD conversion contract is unresolved.

controls.label: USSD Sonic CrossChainRouter redemption and compose controller

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: CrossChainRouter.send() transfers USSD into the router, calls the local BrandedCustodian.redeem() to burn USSD for frxUSD, and sends the backing through RemoteHopV201; hopCompose() deposits received frxUSD to mint destination USSD.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: setHopV2Address() and relayer-controlled destination-router configuration bind the router to the Hop path; destination-specific router addresses were not enumerated in this pass.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: The router hands frxUSD to the Sonic RemoteHop and LayerZero endpoint; validator/DVN/executor validation is represented by the common Hop controls below.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No router-local rate-limit control was resolved. mintAndSend() was disabled while isolatedBackingEnabled was false on the current Sonic and Ethereum reads.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Sonic role-grant logs at block 64151860 granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and RELAYER_ROLE to Safe 0x87c7a1ef67c67cd57cbf101522a0c3b19d2c3aac, with BrandedFactory 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d as grant sender. The router is non-proxy; the Safe-held admin can replace the Hop address and the relayer can set non-deterministic destination routers.

controls.evidence: The verified CrossChainRouter at Sonic 0x2f30bef74c1f7572a3ea5e101d1f587287d06c94 implements send(), mintAndSend(), hopCompose(), and setHopV2Address(). At the fixed Sonic review, role-grant history assigned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and RELAYER_ROLE to Safe 0x87c7a1ef67c67cd57cbf101522a0c3b19d2c3aac; the router is not a USSD token MINTER_ROLE holder. Its redemption, compose, Hop-address, and destination-router surfaces are bridge machinery rather than canonical token issuance.

controls.label: USSD Sonic CrossChainRouter Safe administrator

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Safe's CrossChainRouter administration can replace the Hop address and the relayer can set destination-router addresses; these controls are scoped to the five representation routes.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Sonic role-grant logs at block 64151860 assigned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and RELAYER_ROLE on the non-proxy CrossChainRouter to this 3-of-6 Safe; current destination-specific router role sets were not enumerated.

controls.evidence: The Sonic CrossChainRouter's role-grant history assigned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and RELAYER_ROLE to Safe 0x87c7a1ef67c67cd57cbf101522a0c3b19d2c3aac. Existing on-chain Safe evidence records this controller as 3-of-6 with six owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. Its admin and relayer powers govern the bridge route and do not create canonical USSD liabilities.
